resources.string: ScanPesa opens SIM Toolkit and taps through the M-PESA menu, typing in ONLY the phone, paybill, account or till number you confirmed. It stops before the amount and PIN. It never reads or types your PIN, never types an amount and never presses Send or Confirm. It only works inside SIM Toolkit, and only for about 40 seconds after you tap Go. Nothing is sent to the internet.
